The prosecutor says the behavior violates Criminal Law provisions, should be charged with "窝藏罪" (concealing a criminal). In Chinese criminal law, the crime of "窝藏、包庇罪" (concealing a criminal) is the appropriate charge. Also possibly "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪"? Actually there is a crime "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪" (helping a criminal to escape). Under Chinese law, Article 38 of Criminal Law: "帮助犯罪分子逃跑的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "窝藏罪" is Article 38? Wait: Article 38 is "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪". Article 38 also includes "窝藏罪"? Actually "窝藏罪" is Article 38? Let's recall: In Chinese Criminal Law, Article 38: "帮助犯罪分子逃跑的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Then there is Article 38 also includes "窝藏罪"? I think "窝藏罪" is Article 38 as well: "窝藏、包庇犯罪分子" is also covered. Actually Article 38: "帮助犯罪分子逃跑或者窝藏、包庇犯罪分子" is the same article. So the crime is "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪" or "窝藏罪". Usually prosecutors charge "窝藏罪" (concealing a criminal). The facts include giving money to escape (helping to escape) and harboring. In practice, they are combined. The official name is "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪". But the term "窝藏罪" is also used. The question expects the answer "窝藏罪". The example shows they want the exact name. So answer: [罪名]窝藏罪<eoa>.
